name: Westport

variables.label: Two-family / multifamily
variables.quote: In an AAA Residence District, no land, building, or structure shall be used, and no building shall be hereafter erected, altered, or added to, unless otherwise provided in these regulations except for one (1) or more of the following uses: 11-2.1 Principal Uses 11-2.1.1One (1) single-family dwelling per lot.

variables.label: Min. lot size
variables.quote: Each lot shall have a minimum area of two (2) acres (87,120 square feet) and shall be of such shape that a square with two hundred (200) feet on each side will fit on the lot.

variables.label: Two-family
variables.value: Allowed BY RIGHT as a principal use
variables.quote: 18-2.1.1 Any use permitted in a Residence AAA District, as specified in §11-2.1, herein. 18-2.1.2Two-family dwellings.

variables.label: Max density
variables.quote: The maximum unit density shall not exceed one dwelling unit for each 4,350 square feet of gross lot area. The total number of dwelling units shall not exceed a density of 10.0 units per gross acre.

variables.label: Town-wide aggregate cap
variables.value: 120 total dwelling units under this zone
variables.quote: The total aggregate number of dwelling units permitted on all Res. C lots within the Town of Westport shall not exceed 120 cumulative dwelling units under these Res. C regulations.

variables.label: Affordability requirement
variables.quote: A minimum of fifteen percent (15%) of the total number of market rate dwelling units shall be designated as workforce or affordable housing

variables.label: ADU max size (structural, no owner-occ.)
variables.quote: Lots up to and including 1½ acres (0-65,340 sq. ft.) 850 sq. ft. Lots over 1½ acres (65,340 sq. ft. or greater) 1,000 sq. ft.

variables.label: ADU max size (internal apartment, owner-occ. req.)
variables.value: 1,500 sq ft or 25% of total floor area, whichever smaller
variables.quote: The additional dwelling unit shall not exceed 1500 square feet of floor area or 25% of the total floor area in the dwelling, whichever is smaller.

variables.label: ADU availability
variables.value: Excluded — §11-2.4.12 accessory apartment provision not carried over
variables.quote: Any Special Permit use allowed in a Residence AAA District, as specified in §11-2.2 & 11-2.3 herein, except §11-2.4.12 (Accessory Apartment) and §11-2.4.5 (Leasing of Rooms) is not allowed.

variables.label: Parking, developments ≤16 units
variables.value: No minimum (2026 amendment, §34-14.1), except in a Conservation & Traffic Mitigation District
variables.quote: A development with sixteen (16) or fewer dwelling units does not need to provide a minimum number of off-street parking spaces unless such development is located in a Conservation and Traffic Mitigation District (CTMD).

variables.label: Min. unit size
variables.value: Not found as a minimum; only caps located (e.g. ADU ≤800 sq ft, GBD units averaging ≤2,100 sq ft)
variables.cite: full-text search, not completed within research budget

variables.label: Inclusionary zoning
variables.value: IHZ: ≥20% of floor area deed-restricted affordable. R-AHZ/W: reported 30% affordable/workforce split
variables.quote: In conjunction with residential units proposed as part of this regulation, at least twenty percent (20%) of the floor area of all residential units shall be deed restricted as affordable

variables.label: Historic overlay
variables.value: Multi-layered system — the most elaborate of the CT-4 towns researched; section text not independently re-verified

variables.label: Demolition delay
variables.value: 180 days for structures ≥50 years old and ≥500 sq ft (raised from 90 days in 2008)

source.title: Town of Westport, Demolition Delay Ordinance

variables.quote: The Town of Westport has a demolition delay ordinance, §14-21, that provides a 180 day waiting period following the filing of a demolition permit application for buildings 500 sq. ft. or larger and 50 years or older.

variables.label: Coastal/flood overlay
variables.value: Applies — Long Island Sound frontage; ~3,100 properties in the 100-year flood zone per town staff reports

nza_metrics.label: Residential land with a parking mandate

caveat: A 2026 amendment (§34-14.1) eliminated minimum parking entirely for residential developments of 16 units or fewer townwide. No local PDF mirror exists for Westport (browsable encodeplus code site, not a single PDF), so these facts carry citations but not independently re-verified quotes.
